title: governance: add the OWNER_LINUX host kind
summary: common.schema.json gains the host kind OWNER_LINUX for the Framework machine, and a LOCAL runtime may name OWNER_MACBOOK or OWNER_LINUX. A valid Gate 1 example with a Linux local worker proves the change. GOVERNANCE_LINUS.md names the second local machine. The gatekeeper holds this packet because the paths are protected.

lane.reason: The gatekeeper persona codes this packet on a Cursor cloud VM. docs/governance is a protected path and only a GATEKEEPER or OWNER worker may hold it. No macOS tool is needed.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add OWNER_LINUX to the host_kind enum and change the LOCAL rule's const to the two-value enum. schema_version stays 2.0.0 because every valid payload stays valid. Add docs/governance/examples/valid/gate1-local-linux-worker.json: a copy of an existing Gate 1 packet payload, with a new packet_id in the PKT-9xxx range that no packet uses, whose worker has runtime LOCAL, host kind OWNER_LINUX, host name framework, os the Linux release, arch x86_64, and model provider ANTHROPIC with tool CURSOR_IDE. In GOVERNANCE_LINUS.md section I and section VIII name the Framework laptop as a second LOCAL machine for every crate except kate-ui and apps. cargo run -p gatecheck --locked fails on main with the new example present because OWNER_LINUX is not in the enum, and passes after the schema change. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: all_examples_and_packets_validate
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main when the new valid example is present because the schema rejects OWNER_LINUX. After the schema change every example and packet validates.
